description: Figure 7 presents a bar chart illustrating CoLeG-R values for different LLaMA-2 model scales. The horizontal axis displays the model names: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B, listed in ascending order of parameter count. The vertical axis, labeled “CoLeG-R (%)”, represents the CoLeG-R score, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, and tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Three bars are displayed for each model scale, representing different SFT conditions: “no SFT”, “SFT on D1”, and “SFT on D1, D2”. The bars are color-coded, with “no SFT” in blue, “SFT on D1” in orange, and “SFT on D1, D2” in green. For LLaMA-2-7B, the “no SFT” bar reaches approximately 20, “SFT on D1” reaches approximately 50, and “SFT on D1, D2” reaches approximately 60. For LLaMA-2-13B, the “no SFT” bar reaches approximately 30, “SFT on D1” reaches approximately 60, and “SFT on D1, D2” reaches approximately 70. Finally, for LLaMA-2-70B, the “no SFT” bar reaches approximately 40, “SFT on D1” reaches approximately 65, and “SFT on D1, D2” reaches approximately 75. Within each model scale, the bars are grouped together, with each group representing the effect of the different SFT conditions. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
